# Active Notify (Shared Procedure)

  All notify.sh surfaces (`arm`, `fire-now`) are model-side Bash dispatches, and
  the model may self-cancel a cycle it opened.

  The third subcommand is named here ONLY as the trailing segment of
  `self-cancel`. A word boundary that treats the hyphen as a break would count
  that as coverage this file does not have, so this fixture must stay red.
